item.title: React Now Rusted All The Way Out
item.content:encoded: The transition to the Rust version of the React Compiler for the 1,036-file React Router codebase resulted in a significant speed increase, improving build times from 14.3 seconds to 0.81 seconds. The new compiler addresses previous limitations and ensures consistency across the toolchain, making it easier to manage builds with enhanced performance and capabilities.
